metadata.dataContract: HIS-ready core metrics only; diagnosis-dependent fields are optional and omitted.

metadata.cohortDefinition: Patients admitted to ICU/HDU during August 2026; outcomes are followed through the same inpatient admission episode.

privacy.note: Aggregate values are derived from the validated August workbook. Death-case detail rows are de-identified prototype rows and should not be used as clinical source data.

metadata.cohortDefinition: Patients admitted to ICU/HDU during September 2026; outcomes are followed through the same inpatient admission episode.

privacy.note: Aggregate values and de-identified death-case attributes are derived from the validated September workbook. Synthetic case IDs are used; direct patient identifiers are excluded.
